title: Single file: fingerprints and a baseline
description: A standalone file gets fingerprints too; its package is the anonymous package of the file. A baseline can be given with --baseline-path; a Scan.toml next to the file is not read, as for every setting. With a baseline only the new issues are printed, and a single file saves no report, so the baselined findings are only counted in the summary. Recorded to see what the tool does; BEP 1498 does not single out standalone files. Needs scan 0.15.0+.
upstream: BEP 1498: Finding fingerprints and baseline adoption (ballerina-spec/beps/tool-scan/1498_scan_baseline.md)
